_comment: Build + deploy manifest. Resolution order for bundle→Lambda-function-name mapping: (1) client_artifacts[client], (2) artifacts, (3) derive from apps. A bundle listed in 'apps' but absent from both 'artifacts' and the client's client_artifacts entry will be built but never uploaded — add it to the appropriate map to enable deployment.

forge-core._comment_clients: Exhaustive list of clients that use this workspace. build-matrix.js validates against this list — clients not listed here are never deployed from this workspace, even if they exist in clients.json.
forge-core._comment_artifacts: Default bundle→Lambda mapping used by any client without a client_artifacts override. 'migrate' is intentionally absent — only clients with a deployed migrator Lambda should map it; add via client_artifacts instead.
forge-core._comment_client_artifacts: Per-client overrides. An entry here replaces 'artifacts' entirely for that client — list every bundle the client needs, including migrate if the client has a migrator Lambda.
